## What it is
We explored the effects of alcohol and caffeine consumption on sleep efficiency and deep sleep using the [Sleep Efficiency Dataset](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/equilibriumm/sleep-efficiency) from Kaggle. Machine models used in the analyses included linear regression, tree, LDA / QDA, ridge regression, and LASSO. We presented our findings at Willamette's Student Scholarship Recognition Day.


## What I did

- Conducted background research and wrote the introduction
- Coded and presented the linear models.
- Combined code from all authors into a single markdown.
- Caffeine differently affected males (positive) and females (negative).
- Alcohol was negatively associated with sleep quality overall.
- The negative effect of alcohol was amplified in smokers when compared to non-smokers.
